facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report during commissioning of replacement equipment on P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3220 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 January 2012 a hazard report was recorded on P-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
